content: Sounpei en Epraim ko ahpw kaunopada ong mahwen; re kotehla Pillap Sordan kolahng Sapon oh ndaiong Sepda, “Dahme komw kotehkihla irepen sahpw en pwe komwi en mahweniong mehn Ammon kan, ke ahpw sohte ekerkin kiht pwe se en iang komwi? Se pahn isikala tehnpasomwien pohmwi.”
Ahpw Sepda ndaiong irail, “Ngehi oh nei aramas akan se nanpwungsuwediongada mehn Ammon kan. I likwerih kumwail, ahpw kumwail sohte kapitiehla sang irail.

Ni ei kilangehr me kumwail sohte pahn sewesei ie, I mehndahkihla ei mour oh kotehla irepen sahpwo pwe I en mahweniong irail, KAUN-O eri ketikihong ie I en poweiraildi. Eri, dahme kumwail ketikihdohki pwehn mahweniong ie?”

Sepda eri kapokonepene sounpei en Kilead koaros oh mahweniong mehn Epraim ko, e ahpw poweiraildi. (Mehn Epraim ko patohwanehr, “Kumwail mehn Kilead kan nan sapwen Epraim oh Manase, kumwail sopohsangehr Epraim!”)

Mehn Kilead kalowehdi wasa kan me aramas kak kotehla ni Pillap Sordan, pwe re en silehdi mehn Epraim pwe re de tangdoaui. Ni ahnsou me mehn Epraim kin song en tangdoaui oh pahn kin peki mweimwei en kotehla pillapo, mehn Kilead ko kin idek, “Kowe mehn Epraim?” Ma e pahn kin sapeng, nda, “Soh,”

re pahn kin ndahng en kin nda, “Dipoled.” Ahpw e pahn kin nda, “Tipoled,” pwehki ar sis sohte mwahu ong lepin mahsen wet. Irail eri pahn kin koledi oh kemehla wasao. Ni ahnsowo mehn Epraim pahkid riemen kamakamala.
Sepda kaunda Israel erein sounpar weneu. Mwuhr e ahpw mehla oh seridi nan eh kahnimw nan Kilead.
Mwurin Sepda, Ipsan mehn Pedleem uhd kaunda Israel.

E naineki pwutak siliakan oh serepein siliakan. E kapwopwoudihala nah serepein ko likin eh peneinei oh pil wahdo serepein siliakan likin eh peneinei pwe re en pwoudikihda nah pwutak ko. Ipsan kaunda Israel erein sounpar isuh,
mwuhr e ahpw mehla oh seridi Pedleem.
Mwurin Ipsan, Elon sang Sepulon kaunda Israel erein sounpar eisek.
Mwuhr e ahpw mehla oh seridi nan Aisalon nan sapwen Sepulon.
Mwurin Elon, Apdon, nein Ihlel mehn Piradon me kaunda Israel.
E naineki pwutak pehk, oh nah pwutak ko naineki pwutak siliakan, me kin dake ahs isiakan. Apdon kaunda Israel erein sounpar waluh.
E ahpw mehla oh seridi nan Piradon nan sapwen Epraim nan sahpw nahnahn mehn Amalek ko.
